title: Boutique Lounge Layout Planner with Budget Conservation
description: The user designs a high-end fashion boutique lounge by placing and configuring sofas and decorative corset mannequin displays within a floor plan. A fixed budget constrains all operations: adding, moving, rotating, scaling, and recoloring items all cost points, and removing items refunds points. The user must arrange an aesthetically balanced lounge using undo/redo to optimize their layout within budget.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load SheenWoodLeatherSofa.glb as a placeable lounge sofa and Corset.glb as a decorative mannequin display piece. Scene: a 12x12 unit rectangular floor with a subtle grid texture representing a boutique lounge floor plan. Use warm ambient light (0xfff5e6) plus two directional lights simulating showroom lighting. Camera starts at a 45-degree elevated angle looking at the floor center. UI panel on the left shows: current budget (starts at 1000 points), item palette with Sofa (cost 150) and Corset Display (cost 80), and action buttons. Interactions: (1) Click palette item then click floor to place a clone at that grid-snapped position (deducts cost). (2) Select any placed item by clicking it (highlight with outline). (3) Drag selected item to reposition (costs 20 per move). (4) Press R to rotate selected item 45 degrees (costs 10). (5) Press +/- to scale selected item between 0.5x-2.0x in 0.25 steps (costs 15 per step). (6) Press C to cycle through 4 tint colors: default, gold, crimson, navy (costs 25). (7) Press Delete to remove selected item (refunds original placement cost only). (8) Budget conservation law: total spent minus refunds must never exceed 1000; disable actions when insufficient funds and show warning. (9) Implement full undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y) that correctly reverses budget changes. (10) Display a live item count and remaining budget. All placed objects cast shadows onto the floor. Show a translucent placement preview ghost when hovering floor with palette item selected. Prevent overlapping placements using bounding box collision. Store each action as a command object with execute/undo methods for the undo system.
